parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The device ID. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and is the unique identifier of the device.
> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. IotId is the globally unique identifier of the device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.

parameters.name: Props
parameters.description:
The device tags to set. You can set multiple tags.

Device tags are in JSON format. The structure of each tag is **Key:Value**. **Key** is the tag name, and **Value** is the corresponding tag value.

Separate multiple tags with commas (,). Example: **Props={"color":"red","shape":"round"}**.

 ><notice> 
- The total size of **Props** cannot exceed 5 KB.
- `abc` is a tag **Key** reserved by IoT Platform. You cannot set a tag **Key** to abc. If you set `Key=abc`, the tag is filtered out when you search by tags.

></notice>
